text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon placed excellently in the
Twinkle
Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hand in hand, we've been able to work
our way
through the first three pivotal
years of her career.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On a day of respite, while basking in the
glory of
our accomplishments...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Saying that she wants to conduct a
psychological
test, Agnes Tachyon
makes herself comfortable in
my office.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
An object is buried deep in your
backyard. What
is this object?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't really get the meaning behind
the
question, but I suppose I have no
choice but to
play along.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What types of things might be buried in
a yard?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The answer you choose reveals the one
thing you
wish for someone else to
uncover.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Color me surprised.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
There's no way! We've been tricked once
again!
How bold of them to claim a
one-hundred
percent accuracy rate.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Regardless of that, I'm more curious
about the
reason behind her sudden
interest in
psychological tests.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
At present, I am studying the
fundamental factor
behind the social
animal, the factor otherwise
known as
"emotion."
choice_data_list: A psychological test out of nowhere? What's going on?
A personality quiz all of a sudden? What brought this on?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I faintly remember her saying something
similar
once before.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Lately, I've become increasingly curious
about the
powers that stem from factors
like "enthusiasm"
and "passion."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thinking back on it, she expressed her
interest in
emotions quite a while before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I thought it was a passing curiosity, but
that no
longer seems to be the case.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Something opened my eyes, you see. It
was
during the Arima Kinen, from the
stands.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
After I placed first... I was assailed by a

thunderous applause—a roaring cheer.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
That raw energy emanating from the
stands was
enough to make my hair
stand on end—to make
my heart race. I
was utterly dumbfounded.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It was at that moment when the notion
came to
me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Winning the race that day... No, not just
that, but
managing to reach the Classics
with my own two
feet...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
All of these accomplishments were,
perhaps, only
possible due to emotion.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It occurred to me that I might have
severely
underestimated the true extent
of its power.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I've always recognized the importance of
its
effects on muscular activity, both
internal and
external.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
However, the results have far exceeded
my
predictions. Observing its potential
has been such
a thrill!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Indubitably, this holds the key to further
research
that will allow us to surpass our
limitations!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I thought it prudent to draw
upon
references from a wide range of
literature in order
to further my research.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon turns to face me,
squinting.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
As luck would have it, I have, at my beck
and call,
a guinea pig highly responsive
to emotions of
every sort.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
In these three years, thanks to your
feelings, I
have...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She stops mid-sentence.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Um, n-never mind. Let's drop this
subject.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...Shut up. Forget everything I said.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, you're my trainer, which means
you must
be earnest in your duties as my
guinea pig!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After that, I'm forced to undergo
psychological
test after psychological
test till dusk.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Anyhow, my new journey together with
Agnes
Tachyon has only just begun.
